blocks.text: Yeh chapter dekhta hai ke algorithms se masail kaise hal hote hain; algorithms kaam karne ki qadam ba qadam hidayaat hain. Algorithms samajhna sirf computer science nahi balke rozmarra ke masail hal karne ke liye bhi zaroori hai. Chapter yeh batane se shuru hota hai ke computational masail kya hain aur unhein wazeh kaise bayan karein, phir mukhtalif qism ke algorithms dekhta, aur behtareen hal dhoondne ke liye un ki kaarkardagi (efficiency) naapne par baat karta hai.

blocks.title: Computational problem
blocks.text: Computational problem aisa challenge hai jo computational amal se hal ho sakta hai: algorithm, yaani mehdood (finite) qadam ba qadam hidayaat jo computer chala sake.

items: Input: algorithm ko diya gaya data ya maloomat.
Process: input par lagaye jane wale qadam ya qawaid.
Output: input par amal ke baad milne wala hal ya nateeja.

blocks.prompt: Do adad mein se bara dhoondne ke liye input, process aur output bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Input: do adad. Process: un ka muwazna. Output: bara adad.

items: Computational problem algorithm se hal hota hai: input se process ke zariye output tak qadmon ka mehdood silsila.
